_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for council config. Route rule SOT = Anh chỉ đạo. Do not use a cost chain. The 2026-07-25 benchmark table is SUSPENDED. Edit here, then run council_config_sync when derived council docs change. Known CLIs keep built-in argv branches; optional argv overrides remain supported.

clau.label: ClauC
clau.role: Judgement and scoped bug-fix on existing code with a narrow evidence pack. Master dev only when the same issue has failed council retry more than 2 times. MCP only for explicit T4/runtime/DOM/CDP/browser stateful work. Not for broad scan/read/context gathering or new-code creation. Dispatch via claudeltnai with live LTNAI Claude Opus 5. Catalog also has claude-opus-4-8 and claude-sonnet-5.
clau.cli_channel: claudeltnai --print --model claude-opus-5 -p "<prompt>"  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_clau.txt]

codo.label: CodoC
codo.role: High-end council worker on CodexLTNAI grok-4.6-build when Anh names CodoC: judgement, independent audit, high-difficulty development, code building, plan drafting, and final conflict resolution. CodoC is not the default leader and is not for broad evidence scans. ox-alpha deferred. GPT Sol discontinued.
codo.cli_channel: codexltnai exec --ephemeral --model grok-4.6-build -c model_reasoning_effort="xhigh" --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --skip-git-repo-check "<prompt>"  [uses CODEX_HOME=.codex-ltnai; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_codo.txt]

kilo.label: KiloC
kilo.role: Kilo harness. No Anh-directed default route cell. Do not apply the suspended 2026-07-25 MiniMax/Qwen/DeepSeek defaults. Use only when Anh names KiloC or a live pin already exists after SET+GET.
kilo.cli_channel: kilo run "<prompt>" --model ltnai/glm-5.2 --format json --dangerously-skip-permissions  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_kilo.txt; cwd set by subprocess not --dir]

pic.label: PiC
pic.role: Pi harness. No Anh-directed default route cell. Do not apply the suspended 2026-07-25 Qwen/DeepSeek/MiniMax/Sol defaults. Use only when Anh names PiC or a live pin already exists after SET+GET.
pic.cli_channel: pi --print --no-session --approve --provider <provider> --model <model> --thinking high "<prompt>"  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_pic.txt]

ope.label: OpeC
ope.role: OpenCode harness. Live pin openai-compatible/grok-4.6-build (LTNAI) until Anh changes it. Suspended 2026-07-25 Qwen/MiniMax/Sol/Kimi defaults are not live routes.
ope.cli_channel: opencode run "<prompt>" --model <model> --thinking --dangerously-skip-permissions  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_ope.txt]

hermes.label: HermC
hermes.role: Hermes harness. No Anh-directed default route cell. Do not apply the suspended 2026-07-25 MiniMax/Qwen/DeepSeek defaults. Use only when Anh names HermC or a live pin already exists after SET+GET.
hermes.cli_channel: hermes chat -q "<prompt>" --yolo -t web,file [-m <model>] [--provider <prov>] [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_hermes.txt]

gro.label: GroC
gro.role: Grok CLI worker on live LTNAI wire ID grok-4.6-build. Grok-native reasoning plus loaded design/bugs-scan/code skills. Dispatch via council_message.
gro.cli_channel: C:\Users\ADMIN\.grok\bin\grok.exe -p "<prompt>" -m grok-4.6-build --yolo  [diagnostic only; dispatch via council_message; log .council\log_gro.txt]

coordination_rule: The user-triggered desktop/current CA that loads leader-council-skill is the temporary leader; no CA identity is hard-coded as leader. ROUTE RULE SOT = Anh chỉ đạo. Classify RISK_LEVEL and DEV_LEVEL as measurement metadata only. Do not map them to the suspended 2026-07-25 table. Route only when Anh names the worker/model or after council_worker_model SET+GET of the live pin. CodoC is a worker route, not leader by default. ClauC is exceptional-only. No cost chain.
parallelism_rule: The current leader CA may dispatch independent tasks in parallel when output ownership is disjoint. Serialize overlapping writes. RISK_LEVEL and DEV_LEVEL set the verification floor; they do not select a worker/model from the suspended table.
mission: Route only from Anh chỉ đạo or the live pin after SET+GET. RISK_LEVEL x DEV_LEVEL is measurement metadata, not a route table. CodoC is a worker, ClauC exceptional-only, no cost chain. Benchmark 2026-07-25 table SUSPENDED.
guardrail_harness_rule: The current CA reading leader-council-skill is leader. Do not apply the suspended benchmark table. CodoC is a high-end worker when Anh names CodoC, not a hard-coded leader. ClauC is excluded from normal routing order.

task_routing.SOT: Anh chỉ đạo. Benchmark 2026-07-25 table SUSPENDED. Do not use PiC+Qwen, KiloC+MiniMax, CodoC+ox-alpha, CodoC+GPT-5.6 Sol, PiC+DeepSeek, OpeC+Qwen, or Kimi DEFAULT_OFF as live defaults. Route only when Anh names the worker/model or after SET+GET of the live pin.
